Is equally as absurd. 

I normally don't post negative things about companies... but even if you don't see material revenue or roadmap changes in the next 2 years.

text: I know many people in the industry, have published research on it, built games myself. Almost every indie studio and game designer is just going to lie about using AI and live in fear of their fans. And solo developers & larger studios will not be punished the same way.

Anyhow, in a little over a week we will see the release of The Last Human Game.

There will never be another AAA game at the scale of GTA 6 with no AI assistance. People will look back at an all-human game with a billion dollar budget and wonder how they did it, like the Pyramids
Hey, remember “talk to your documents” RAG-based solutions as the future of AI? Crazy times a year and a half ago.

The counterexample to AI diffusion taking a long time is coding, where the complete transformation of a profession is well underway less than a year after real working coding agents. Faster than I would’ve expected given historical technological adoption rates in professions.

You don’t have to love powerlooms or hate hand weaving to recognize a powerloom when you see one.

Lots of intellectual tasks that used to be pure craft & which, therefore, could never be industrialized might soon be subject to the logic of industrialization. Not an easy change.
We should spend more effort thinking about how to preserve craft and augment it, automation is seductive but not an inevitable path.

text:
从美国就业看职业变化，软件行业基本已经停滞，部分职业消失趋势非常明显，AI 数据中心相关的实体岗位大幅增加
就像工业革命对蓝领打击很大一样，
AI 这次是智能的工业革命，对白领的打击是很大的

1. 科技公司有超过281,000个空缺职位，比一年前增长了17% 
2.产品经理、工程和设计职位仅增长了2%。
3. 设计（−28%）和用户体验研究（−45%）实际上是缩减了。  
4. 那么增长从哪里来？硬件工程职位空缺翻了一番。业务运营新增了约4,200个空缺。供应链增长了63%。
许多增长最快的职位都是实体岗位：数据中心技术员、安装工、现场服务工程师。  人工智能热潮正在创造就业机会，但主要是建设并运营实体基础设施（芯片、数据中心、硬件），而不是构建软件。

quoted_tweet.author: Lenny Rachitsky
quoted_tweet.text:
The tech job market is in its best shape in years. But almost none of the growth is coming from software jobs.

There are 281,000+ open roles at tech companies, up 17% from a year ago and 73% from the March 2023 low.

But open PM, eng, and design roles grew just 2%. Design (−28%) and UX research (−45%) actually shrank.

So where’s the growth coming from? Hardware engineering openings doubled. Business ops added ~4,200 openings. Supply chain is up 63%. Many of the fastest-growing jobs are physical: data center technicians, installers, field service engineers.

The AI boom is creating jobs, but mostly in building and running the physical infrastructure (chips, data centers, hardware), not building software.

Times, they are a-changin’.

Full report: https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/state-of-the-tech-job-market-late
